development_exposed: yes - batch1; HF/IRC-extrap test; V0/field-calibration case
quantity: Tavg: CFD monitor 'Average chip surface temperature' (area-averaged by the CFD solver)

history.note: CFD monitor; the forecaster's input history (30 s window ending at the origin)

target_rule: target_index = origin_index + 2*h (dt = 0.5 s); target_time = origin_time + h

model.inputs: last 30 s of [Tavg monitor, Tf monitor, Q, flow]; Q, flow and Tf held at their origin value (no future information); no absolute time
model.output: Tavg at origin + h, h = 1..60 s (one trajectory per origin)
model.seed_note: Seed spread = min/max of 3 training runs (seeds 0,1,2). Not a calibrated uncertainty.

baselines.R2_KF_W: Two-mode lumped thermal model + Kalman filter on the same 30 s window
baselines.TREND: Linear trend over the last 30 s

metric_definition: Over the 156 main origins t_k = 60.5..835.5 s (stride 5 s, overlapping, not independent); error = forecast - CFD Tavg at t_k + h.
